text:
My daily routine is built around consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six-thirty each morning, and my first habit is drinking a glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I review my to-do list while eating a light breakfast of yogurt and fruit.

My work schedule starts at nine. I usually focus on deep tasks in the morning, when I feel most alert, and save emails and meetings for the afternoon. At lunch, I take a short walk, and I always do thirty minutes of exercise after work—either jogging or stretching.

Evenings are simple: I cook dinner, read for pleasure, and prepare my clothes for the next day. By ten-thirty, I am in bed. This steady rhythm keeps me calm and efficient.
